borromean_special_case.interpretation: Borromean Markov trace is purely even in h; no odd-h terms; so bar-anti-symmetric companion vanishes. Structural prediction: baryon has no EM-channel mass contribution (consistent with baryon mass being dominantly strong-force).

description:
DERIVED generalizations of PR #1125 binomial pattern + PR #1153 sinh partner. Verifies 4 identities symbolically for m = 0..6:
  (I1) Q_m/P_m = tanh((2m+1)η)
  (I2) P_m² - Q_m² = 1/[2]_q²  ← Pythagorean GENERALIZATION
  (I3) P_m + Q_m = q^{2m+1}/[2]_q
  (I4) P_m - Q_m = q^{-(2m+1)}/[2]_q
Plus Borromean special case: Q = 0 (zero EM channel).
key_finding: Pythagorean identity (I2) is m-INDEPENDENT: P_m² - Q_m² = 1/[2]_q² for ALL m. This constrains the EM-channel residual Q_m and the bar-symmetric mass P_m to lie on a 'hyperbolic circle' (cosh²-sinh² = 1, normalized by 1/(2 cosh η)²).
